title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on Acts 26: Paul's defense before King Agrippa, the light on the road to Damascus, and the answers of Festus and Agrippa.

questions.text: Who told Paul, "You may speak for yourself"?
questions.explanation: Agrippa said to Paul that he might speak for himself, and Paul stretched out his hand and made his defense.

answers.text: Festus
Felix
Claudius Lysias
Agrippa

questions.text: According to the strictest sect of their religion, how did Paul say he had lived?
questions.explanation: Paul said that those who had known him from the first could testify that after the strictest sect of their religion he lived a Pharisee.

answers.text: As a Sadducee
As a Pharisee
As a scribe
As a priest of the temple

questions.text: Who does Paul say earnestly serve night and day, hoping to attain the promise made by God to the fathers?
questions.explanation: Paul says he stands to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to the fathers, which the twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain.

answers.text: The elders of Jerusalem
The prophets of old
The twelve tribes
The Gentiles who fear God

questions.text: What did Paul say he did to many of the saints in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Paul said he shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests, and gave his vote against them when they were put to death.

answers.text: He shut many of them up in prisons
He drove them out of the temple
He taught them in the synagogues
He warned them to flee the city

questions.text: At what time of day did Paul see the light on the way to Damascus?
questions.explanation: Paul said that at noon he saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around him and his companions.

answers.text: At midnight
At noon
At sunrise
At the third hour of the night

questions.text: In what language did Paul say the voice spoke to him?
questions.explanation: When they had all fallen to the earth, Paul heard a voice speaking to him in the Hebrew language.

answers.text: In the Greek language
In the Latin language
In the language of the Egyptians
In the Hebrew language

questions.text: What did the voice say Paul was sent to do for those to whom he was sent?
questions.explanation: He was sent to open their eyes, that they might turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, and receive remission of sins.

answers.text: To open their eyes, that they might turn from darkness to light
To number them among the twelve tribes of Israel
To build them a house of prayer in Jerusalem
To teach them to keep the feasts of their fathers

questions.text: What did Paul declare that people should do, from Damascus to Judea and to the Gentiles?
questions.explanation: Paul declared that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.

answers.text: Be circumcised and keep the whole law of Moses
Go up to Jerusalem to worship in the temple
Repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance
Sell their goods and give to the poor

questions.text: What did Festus say with a loud voice as Paul made his defense?
questions.explanation: Festus said with a loud voice, "Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!"

answers.text: That Paul should be taken away and beaten
That Paul was crazy and his great learning was driving him insane
That Paul had spoken against Caesar and the law
That Paul had convinced him of everything he said

questions.text: What did Agrippa say to Paul after Paul asked whether he believed the prophets?
questions.explanation: Agrippa said to Paul, "With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?"

answers.text: He said that he believed none of the words of the prophets
He ordered Paul to be silent and led out of the hearing
He asked to be baptized before the governor that day
He asked whether Paul was trying with a little persuasion to make him a Christian
